data.name: Ex/l
data.detailed_description:
A top-down, 2D survival sandbox where you wash up on a procedurally generated island, scrape together your first tools, build a base, and try to outlast other players.

Chop trees, mine rock, stitch gear from whatever you can find, and turn a patch of beach into a fortress. Every run is different, and every sound could be someone scouting your walls.
data.about_the_game:
A top-down, 2D survival sandbox where you wash up on a procedurally generated island, scrape together your first tools, build a base, and try to outlast other players.

Chop trees, mine rock, stitch gear from whatever you can find, and turn a patch of beach into a fortress. Every run is different, and every sound could be someone scouting your walls.
data.short_description: A top-down 2D survival shooter with base building and crafting. Explore procedurally generated islands, secure resources, and defend—or raid—player bases in tense online PvP. Every run reshapes routes, chokepoints, and risk.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.5 GHz (Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300 or equivalent)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated DX11-capable GPU (Intel HD 4000 / AMD Radeon R5 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Onboard / any
  • Additional Notes: 64-bit CPU & OS required. Keyboard & mouse recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad-core 3.0 GHz (Intel Core i5-7500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or better)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX11 GPU with 2 GB VRAM (NVIDIA GTX 950 / AMD RX 460 or better; recent Intel UHD/iGPU also fine)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Onboard / any
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for fastest loading. Stable connection required for online multiplayer.

content_descriptors.notes: This game includes realistic violence. When living targets are hit, blood splashes can appear on the ground. Corpses remain after death, sometimes with small blood pools, and players can loot corpses. No dismemberment, torture, sexual content, drug use, or gambling. Online PvP and optional in-game chat may expose players to competitive or intense interactions.
